project: Constellation v6 — the Level-0 Harness, in its native language

context.summary: Grounding, escalate/resume, supervision, the dictionary emitter and a bounded spine are all merged and green (41 tests, 0 warnings). But the fan-out that built them bypassed Made Well: every implementer wrote its own tests, which is the one wall this project holds sacred. A Pane Compiler PRD also arrived from a separate conversation — the context-pane thesis turned into a blueprint for Constellation's context layer.
context.openThread: d001 — independent verification of the five merged packages plus claim.lisp and spine.lisp. Their tests were written by the agents that wrote the code, so the suite proves self-consistency, not correctness. Cycle c001 is planned and awaits the Lead's commit to dispatch.
